settings.currencyListCached: Showing currencies from the last successful request — the network is unavailable.

contacts.name: Name

contacts.empty: No contacts yet: add the people, banks and exchangers money moves with.
categories.manage.title: Categories
categories.manage.hint: The group decides where spending lands: mandatory and everyday count in the budget, bookkeeping counts nowhere. Only an unused category can be deleted; archive the rest.
categories.manage.name: Name
rules.title: Category rules
rules.hint: If the comment or the contact name contains the text, use the category. The first matching rule from the top wins; a category you chose is never replaced.

stores.inBudgetHint: This wallet’s spending and income count in the daily budget and month totals.
stores.contactHint: Whose account it is: a bank, an exchange, an exchanger. Sub-accounts share it.

vault.password.title: Change password

errors.INCOMPATIBLE_VAULT: The file was written by an earlier version of the app and cannot be opened by this one.
tx.rate.none: no rate for this date yet — it is filled in on the next price refresh
schedule.dayHint: A shorter month uses its last day

automation.empty: No automations yet. Start with your salary — the daily budget is built on it.
automation.name: Name
automation.checkHint: Before creating a transaction the wallet balance on its date is checked. If it falls short, nothing is created and the run waits for your decision.
automation.rejected.limit: Credit limit of “{store}” exceeded: {required} needed, limit {limit}
automation.event.skipped: Runs skipped after a long break: {count}. You can retry them from the automation history.
budget.intro: Spending limits by category, wallet or in total — per day, week or month.
budget.hint: Mandatory and everyday spending of budget wallets counts, at the rate of each transaction's date.
dailyBudget.title: Daily budget
dailyBudget.noIncome: No income this month yet. Add a salary automation and the daily budget is built on it.

goal.issue.commitment: Needs {need} a month, you can put aside {commitment}
goal.issue.surplus: All goals need {need} a month; usually {surplus} is left over

inflation.hint: Annual inflation by currency — for analytics “in today's money”. Wallet amounts are not affected.

flows.listHint: Money paths of several operations: what went in, what came out and what was lost on the way.
flows.empty: No chains yet. Link operations from an operation's panel.

rates.noRate: No rate for one of the currencies
enrichment.consent.title: Look operations up on the blockchain?
enrichment.consent.what: The app can find a transaction's network fee and status by its hash and offer to add them to the operation.
enrichment.consent.sent: Only the transaction hash and the chosen network leave your device.
enrichment.consent.services: Requests go to public services: mempool.space (Bitcoin), the public Solana RPC and EVM explorers.
enrichment.consent.never: Amounts, wallets, contacts and the password are never sent. Nothing changes without your confirmation.
enrichment.consent.change: You can change this in Settings.
enrichment.applyHint: “Apply” adds the fee to the operation if it has none.
enrichment.event: Blockchain data found for a transaction
enrichment.settingsHint: Finds the network fee and status by hash and offers to add them to the operation.

utilities.name: Name
utilities.kindHint.metered: Amount = meter consumption × tariff. Enter a reading once a month.
utilities.kindHint.static: The same amount as last time; changes when you pay.
utilities.kindHint.housing: Monthly rent; the deposit is added to the first payment.
utilities.noAutomation: None — pay on the due day
utilities.automationHint: If an automation pays the rent, the payment is not counted twice in the plan.

utilities.depositIncluded: The deposit is included in the first payment.

utilityStats.title: Utilities by month

utilityHistory.title: History

stores.kindHint.cash: Money in your pocket. One for the whole app.

stores.kindHint.crypto: Your own wallet: MetaMask, Ledger, Trust Wallet.

stores.kindHint.liability: A mortgage, a loan, an installment: debt and payments.

deposit.noTerms: Enter the rate to see interest earned and ahead
deposit.pds.title: State co-financing (PDS)
deposit.pds.hint: The state adds up to 36,000 ₽ a year to your contributions for 10 years from the first one; a year's money arrives by the end of August of the next year. Contributions up to 400,000 ₽ a year give a 13% tax deduction.
deposit.pds.toFull: Contribute this much more for the full 36,000 ₽

dashboard.widgetHint.cashback: What came back as cashback and points, by card, and what expires soon

purpose.everydayExample: Cash, salary card, credit card for purchases
purpose.transitExample: A tax reserve account, a shared family account, a friend's money

walletSettings.title: Settings: {name}
walletSettings.noAccounts: No sub-accounts yet. Add a card, a deposit or a trading account — each holds its own currency or asset.
wallet.view.title: Exchange section
wallet.importNeedsKey: Trade import works through an API key. Add one in the exchange settings.
envelope.hint: An envelope puts money aside for a purpose without moving it: it stays in the wallet but is marked as taken.
envelope.name: Name
envelope.short: The wallet holds less than is put aside. Free: {free}
envelope.noAssets: The wallet has nothing to put aside yet.
stores.deleteHint: Only an empty wallet without operations can be deleted.
automation.introWallet: Recurring operations across all wallets. New ones are created in a wallet — that is where the ready-made ones are.
utilities.noProperty: Add a property (a flat, a house) first — utilities live inside it.
utilities.dayHint: Empty means the month's end. A month can hold several readings, e.g. on the day you move.
contacts.pastePlaceholder: Paste a requisite: card, IBAN, phone, crypto address…
contacts.noHistory: No operations with this contact yet
contacts.noTurnover: No money moved with this contact yet

settingsShell.title: Settings
dashboard.catalog.title: Widget catalog
dashboard.catalog.description: Pick what to add to the dashboard. The widget takes the first free spot.
dashboard.catalog.allPlaced: Every widget is already on the dashboard.
dashboard.emptyGrid: The dashboard is empty — add widgets with «+».
dashboard.widgetHint.onboarding: First set-up steps: wallets, debts, salary.
dashboard.widgetHint.dailyBudget: How much you can spend today.
dashboard.widgetHint.monthSummary: Income, spending and savings this month.
dashboard.widgetHint.miniCalendar: The month with spending per day.
dashboard.widgetHint.budgets: Limits and how much is used.
dashboard.widgetHint.exchangeBalances: Exchange balances next to the ledger; when they still disagree after every operation, the live balance is set.
dashboard.widgetHint.bybitSync: Operations loaded from the exchange: confirm one by one or all, sync now.
tour.dashboard.grid.title: The dashboard is your grid
tour.dashboard.grid.body: Drag a widget by its header, resize it by the bottom-right corner. Gaps fill themselves. «Hide header» pins a widget.
tour.dashboard.add.title: Add a widget
tour.dashboard.add.body: The «+» button opens the catalog with a description and a live preview of each widget.
tour.dashboard.wallets.title: Wallets by kind
tour.dashboard.wallets.body: Cash is there from the start. Banks, crypto, exchanges, property and loans are added here or with «+» on their group.
tour.dashboard.settings.title: Settings
tour.dashboard.settings.body: Theme, language, currency, categories and budget — in one window with sections on the left.
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.title: Help is always near
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.body: «?» shows the tour of the current screen. Right-click any block for quick actions on it.
tour.wallet.settings.title: Wallet settings
tour.wallet.settings.body: What the money is for, sub-accounts and envelopes, automations and the exchange connection — here.
tour.wallet.views.title: Exchange sections
tour.wallet.views.body: Balance overview, a chart terminal and trade import. The terminal remembers everything in this exchange.
tour.wallet.terminal.title: Terminal
tour.wallet.terminal.body: Coins on the left; drawings and timeframe are saved in the exchange — every exchange has its own terminal.
tour.walletSettings.purpose.title: What the money is for
tour.walletSettings.purpose.body: Decides whether spending counts in the daily budget. A deposit is savings, an exchange is investment, a tax account is transit.
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.title: Envelopes
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.body: Put part of the balance aside for a purpose without moving money. An envelope can back a goal.
tour.walletSettings.presets.title: Ready-made automations
tour.walletSettings.presets.body: Templates for this kind of wallet: salary, loan payment, DCA. Only the amount and date are left to fill in.
tour.walletSettings.importSetup.title: Setting up the import
tour.walletSettings.importSetup.body: After the key, choose what to take from the exchange and where to book it: trades, transfers, Earn, accounts, coins.
tour.walletSettings.importRoutes.title: Where each exchange account goes
tour.walletSettings.importRoutes.body: Funding, Unified and Earn: into their own sub-account, a chosen account, or nowhere.
tour.directory.create.title: New contact
tour.directory.create.body: Type a name and press Enter — the rest is filled in right in the card.
tour.directory.editor.title: A card without dialogs
tour.directory.editor.body: Click a field and edit — it saves itself. Just paste a requisite: its kind and network are detected.
tour.directory.debts.title: Debts
tour.directory.debts.body: The debt is what the operations add up to. The buttons open a transfer of the right kind; set a due date and a note below.
contacts.groupHint: E.g. «Family», «Work», «P2P». Without one the contact is listed under its kind.
tx.deleteConfirmHint: It disappears from the history and balances are recalculated. This cannot be undone.
tx.tradeOnUnified: The trade is booked on «{name}»: spot and futures live on the Unified Trading account.
storeWizard.openingHint: What is already there. Booked as one «Opening balance» operation — neither income nor spending.
storeWizard.openingInvalid: Enter a positive amount and an asset
storeWizard.bybitKeyHint: Optional: a read-only Bybit key. With it the needed sub-accounts appear right away: Unified Trading and the ones Bybit holds coins in. You can add the key later in the exchange settings too.
storeWizard.cardHint: A card is a bank account. The opening balance goes on it; more cards and accounts in this bank can be opened later with «New sub-account».
adjustment.title: Match reality
adjustment.hint: Enter what the account really holds. The difference is booked as a correction: it is neither income nor spending and stays out of budgets and reports. Change the operations before this date later, and the difference is recalculated on its own — the balance stays what you entered.
adjustment.dateHint: Empty means now. A past date compares with the ledger of that moment.
adjustment.empty: Nothing on this account yet. Add an asset below if it is really there.
adjustment.addAsset: An asset the ledger does not know
adjustment.nothing: Enter the actual balance of at least one asset that differs from the ledger.
adjustment.submit: Book the correction | Book the correction ({count}) | Book the correction ({count})
tour.wallet.adjust.title: Match reality
tour.wallet.adjust.body: When the app's balance drifts from the bank or the wallet, enter the real balance: the difference is booked as a correction, not as income or spending.
storeChange.openHint: Turn a bank into a crypto wallet, move an account into another wallet of any kind, make a sub-account a wallet of its own, or merge two accounts. Operations are kept.
storeChange.title: Change kind or move: {name}
storeChange.hint: See what changes first. A .bak copy of the vault is kept before it is applied.
storeChange.nothing: Nothing to change here: the cash wallet stays what it is.
storeChange.actionHint.change_kind: Sub-accounts the new kind can hold move along (a card becomes a token account and so on). The others are split off as archived wallets of the old kind, their operations intact.
storeChange.actionHint.move_to: The account becomes a sub-account of the wallet you pick, even of another kind: its type is matched. A wallet without sub-accounts that holds one asset can be moved in too.
storeChange.actionHint.detach: The sub-account becomes a wallet of its own, of the same kind, with all its operations.
storeChange.actionHint.merge_into: Every operation of this account moves to the one you pick, and this account goes. Transfers between the two would land on one account: they show as conflicts.
storeChange.conflicts: Would not fit after the change: {count}. Fix or delete them, then try again.
storeChange.backupHint: The previous vault is kept next to it as .bak
tour.directory.groups.title: Contact groups
tour.directory.groups.body: The list is split into groups. Set one in the contact's «Group» field; without it the contact goes under its kind: people, companies, exchangers.
reminder.repeatHint: Marking it done moves it to the next date. The day is kept: the 31st becomes a short month's last day.
reminder.autoEditHint: This is an automatic reminder: after an edit its time stays yours and the sync leaves it alone.
reminder.doneRepeatHint: Done: move it to the next date
reminder.autoHint: Made from the data: a loan, rent, utilities, a deposit, a debt, a goal or a tax. It moves when the day changes and closes the month once the payment is booked. Delete it, and it does not come back.
simulation.title: Automations, tried out
simulation.hint: The automations run day by day on a copy of the vault, as the scheduler would run them. Nothing is written, so try anything.
simulation.nothing: The automations do nothing in this time.
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.title: Try without risk
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.body: «Try it out» runs the automations ahead on a copy of the vault: what would be created, where money would run short and what the balances would be. Nothing is written.
tour.planningReminders.filter.title: Yours and automatic
tour.planningReminders.filter.body: The app reminds you of loan, rent and utility payments, deposits ending, debts, goals and taxes by itself: those are «Auto». Edit or stop one in the «More» menu; switch whole kinds on and off in Settings → Notifications.
notices.title: Notifications
notices.hint: Everything the app told you: reminders, alerts, payments, money running short. Click one to go there.
notices.systemHint: Show notices outside the app window too. Inside the app they always come.
notices.hideDetails: Hide details while the vault is locked
notices.hideDetailsHint: «Loan payment» without the name and the sum, for when others may see the screen.
notices.defaultTimeHint: When reminders of payments, due dates and taxes come.
notices.catHint.utilities: The utilities pay day and the readings before it
notices.catHint.deposit: A deposit ending, the ПДС contribution
notices.catHint.goal: Saving for a goal and its deadline
notices.catHint.tax: Property tax and tax on deposit interest, when there is a reason
notices.catHint.shortfall: A planned payment the balance will not cover
notices.catHint.budget: A limit nearly used up or exceeded
notices.catHint.automation: Created or rejected by an automation
notices.lockedKeyring: Reminders, due dates and price alerts keep coming: a 60-day schedule is kept encrypted with a key from the system keyring and survives a restart. At unlock everything shown goes into the log without repeats.
notices.lockedMemory: The system keyring is not available, so the schedule is kept in memory only: while the app runs, notices come with the vault locked, but after a restart only once it is unlocked.
notices.autostartHint: The app starts hidden in the tray, so reminders come after a reboot too.
tx.p2p.hint: You send from your account to a person (a P2P seller, an exchanger), they send to your account in another currency.
tx.toCurrencyHint: Not a crypto account: the money arrives in its currency, {code}.
tx.split.linkedHint: All rows are saved as linked operations, one chain.
tx.split.receiveHint: If the money lands on several accounts, add rows: each has its account and amount.
tx.split.receivedTotal: Receiving in total: {total}. What you give is split between the accounts in proportion.
tx.split.topupHint: The top-up is split between the accounts, each with its amount.
tx.missing.title: To save, fill in
tx.missing.toAmount: how much you receive (or the rate)
tx.missing.extra: the accounts and amounts in the «Where I receive» rows
tour.dashboard.bell.title: Notifications
tour.dashboard.bell.body: The bell keeps everything the app told you: reminders, payments, alerts, money running short. Choose what to get in Settings → Notifications.
tour.stores.list.title: All wallets
tour.stores.list.body: Each card is a wallet with its sub-accounts and balance. Click one to open its operations.
tour.stores.create.title: New wallet
tour.stores.create.body: A bank comes with its card right away, an exchange with its Bybit sub-accounts when you give a key.
tour.wallet.operation.title: Record an operation
tour.wallet.operation.body: Top up, pay, transfer, exchange: the asset comes from the account by itself, and the form says what is missing.
tour.walletSettings.change.title: Change kind or move
tour.walletSettings.change.body: In the danger zone: turn a bank into a crypto wallet, move an account into another wallet or merge accounts. You see what changes first.
tour.transactions.tabs.title: Operations views
tour.transactions.tabs.body: The list, the graph of money moving, losses on exchange chains and the spending calendar.
tour.transactions.filter.title: Filter
tour.transactions.filter.body: Wallet, kind, contact, dates and search, by card number and hash too.
tour.transactions.list.title: Operations
tour.transactions.list.body: Click an operation for its details and to link it with others; the pencil edits, the bin deletes.
tour.transactionsLosses.content.title: Losses and chains
tour.transactionsLosses.content.body: Linked operations (a P2P exchange, a move through an exchange) form one chain: here is what went to fees and the rate.
tour.transactionsGraph.content.title: Money graph
tour.transactionsGraph.content.body: Each lane is a wallet, arrows are transfers and exchanges between them. Click a node to open the operation.
tour.transactionsCalendar.content.title: Spending calendar
tour.transactionsCalendar.content.body: What was spent each day of the month and what is planned next.
tour.analytics.tabs.title: Reports
tour.analytics.tabs.body: Cash flow, the year, categories, net worth, wallets, PnL, losses, portfolio and inflation: each looks at money its own way.
tour.analytics.filter.title: Period and wallets
tour.analytics.filter.body: Set the dates, wallets and currency of the report: every chart follows.
tour.analytics.export.title: Export
tour.analytics.export.body: Save the report to a file to open in a spreadsheet.
tour.analytics.cashflow.title: Cash flow
tour.analytics.cashflow.body: Income and spending by month and what was left. Moves between your own accounts and corrections stay out.
tour.analytics.year.title: The year
tour.analytics.year.body: The year by month: where you spent more, where you saved.
tour.analytics.categories.title: Categories
tour.analytics.categories.body: Where money goes: the share of each category and how it changes.
tour.analytics.networth.title: Net worth
tour.analytics.networth.body: Everything you own minus debts, and how it changed.
tour.analytics.stores.title: By wallet
tour.analytics.stores.body: How money splits between wallets and how each one changed.
tour.analytics.pnl.title: PnL
tour.analytics.pnl.body: Realized profit and loss on trades, and the fees.
tour.analytics.losses.title: Losses
tour.analytics.losses.body: Fees and rate losses on exchanges and transfers over the period.
tour.analytics.portfolio.title: Portfolio
tour.analytics.portfolio.body: What the portfolio is made of and how its value moved.
tour.analytics.inflation.title: Inflation
tour.analytics.inflation.body: What money loses to inflation and whether deposits outpace it.
tour.directory.tabs.title: Directory
tour.directory.tabs.body: Contacts with their accounts, and exchange rates.
tour.directory.rates.title: Rates
tour.directory.rates.body: The rates balances and operation prices are counted in; the key rate, for the tax on deposits.
tour.planning.tabs.title: Planning
tour.planning.tabs.body: Automations, limits, goals, reminders and price alerts: everything that looks ahead.
tour.planningAutomations.content.title: Automations
tour.planningAutomations.content.body: Operations on a schedule. They are made on the wallet page; here is the overview and history, on the right what is planned.
tour.planningBudgets.content.title: Limits
tour.planningBudgets.content.body: A limit per day, week or month, on everything, a category or a wallet. When it is nearly used up, you get a notice.
tour.planningGoals.content.title: Goals
tour.planningGoals.content.body: A goal is a sum by a date on the wallets you choose. Say how much to put aside a month and an automatic reminder appears.
tour.planningReminders.content.title: Reminders
tour.planningReminders.content.body: With a date, a time and a repeat. They arrive as notices, even with the vault locked; «done» on a repeating one moves it on.
tour.planningAlerts.content.title: Price alerts
tour.planningAlerts.content.body: A price threshold of an asset in any currency: you are told when the price crosses it.
tour.centerHint: Screen tours: {done} of {total} done. Press ▶ to go through one again.
whatsNew.rename.title: New name: Multi Wallet Tracker
whatsNew.rename.name: TradeApp is now Multi Wallet Tracker (MWT). Your vault, settings, recent files and reminders moved over by themselves — nothing to do.
whatsNew.rename.command: The program now starts as multi-wallet-tracker. If you bound «+ Operation» to a key in Hyprland/Sway, replace trade-app with multi-wallet-tracker there (the ready line is in Settings → General → Quick add).
whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.hint: What changed in the app and where to see it.
whatsNew.round13.title: A big update
whatsNew.round13.vault: The vault was moved to a new format version: data is carried over, the previous file sits next to it as .v1.bak. From now on new fields will not break older files.
whatsNew.round13.adjustment: «Match reality»: enter what the account really holds — the difference is booked as a correction, neither income nor spending. Changing the history before a correction recalculates it on its own.
whatsNew.round13.p2p: Exchange directly or through P2P; what you receive can land on several of your accounts, each with its amount, as one linked chain.
whatsNew.round13.picker: A new account picker: search, the name on top and the details under it, no duplicates. The asset comes from the account, and the form says what is missing.
whatsNew.round13.assetCurrencies: The asset field now offers regular currencies — USD, RUB, EUR with their names — apart from crypto. Fees and losses in them are counted in full at the FX rate. In the recipient picker a contact’s accounts sit indented under it.
whatsNew.round13.notifications: Notices everywhere: a bell with history, money running short, limits, and reminders come even with the vault locked.
whatsNew.round13.autoReminders: Automatic reminders of loan, rent and utility payments, deposits ending, debts, goals and taxes.
whatsNew.round13.reminders: Reminders get a time, a repeat and a snooze.
whatsNew.round13.simulation: «Try it out» for automations: a run ahead on a copy of the vault, nothing written.
whatsNew.round13.storeChange: Change a wallet's kind, move, split off and merge accounts — in the danger zone.
whatsNew.round13.bank: A bank comes with its card: a card is the account.
whatsNew.round13.exchange: Exchange trading lives on the Unified Trading account; Bybit sub-accounts are made from the key.
whatsNew.round13.utilities: Meter readings are dated from a calendar, and «Record expense» and the monthly bill price the latest unpaid readings themselves.
validation.summary: Check the marked fields — the form cannot be saved without them
validation.keyPair: Both the key and the secret are needed — or leave both empty
validation.splitRows: Give each row an account and an amount — or remove the empty row
validation.category: Pick a category — or add a rule in Settings that fills it in
validation.billLines: Tick at least one line with an amount
validation.billAmounts: Every ticked line needs an amount above zero
validation.rates: Every rate needs a date and a percentage of zero or more
validation.duplicateAsset: This asset is already in the list above
validation.confirmName: Type the name «{name}» exactly as it is written
validation.pair: Write a pair like BTCUSDT or BTC/USDT
validation.pickOperations: Tick at least one operation to link
validation.duplicateCurrency: This currency is already in the list
flows.continueNoStore: The operation has no account of yours — there is nothing to continue the chain from
contacts.transferArchived: The contact is archived — restore it to record a transfer
contacts.transferNoStore: Create a wallet first — the transfer is recorded from it
quickAdd.unchanged: This shortcut is already saved — press a new one
whatsNew.round13.forms: Every form marks its required fields with a red *. The Save button is no longer greyed out: press it and each empty or wrong field says what to fix, with the cursor placed in the first one.
workflow.trace.empty: No steps: the trigger leads nowhere.
workflow.name: Workflow name
workflow.missing.errors: fixing the errors: with them a workflow can only be saved switched off
workflow.canvas.empty: Drag a node from the list on the left or press Ctrl+Space. Start with a trigger, for instance «On a schedule».
workflow.leave.title: Edits are not saved
workflow.leave.body: The saved workflow keeps working as it was. What to do with the edits?
workflow.leave.newHint: The new workflow is not saved yet, so it has no draft: save it or leave without it.
workflow.draft.found: There is a draft from {when}: edits kept aside without saving.
workflow.draft.saved: Draft kept: the workflow runs by its saved version
workflow.switchedOn: Workflow on: it watches from now on
workflow.deleted: Workflow deleted; the operations it made stay
workflow.exported: The workflow is copied as text: paste it into «Import» elsewhere
workflow.imported: Workflow added switched off: check it with an emulation
workflow.run.dry.failed: Emulation: an error; for real nothing would be kept
workflow.run.dry.waiting: Emulation: the run would sleep here
workflow.run.dry.asking: Emulation: the workflow asks a question; answer it in the run panel
workflow.run.live.failed: The workflow failed; nothing was kept
workflow.run.live.waiting: The workflow waits and goes on later
workflow.run.live.asking: The workflow waits for your answer under «Queue»
workflow.runPanel.question: The workflow asks
workflow.runPanel.questionHint: In a real run the question shows under «Queue». Answer it here and the emulation goes that way.
workflow.palette.hint: Drag onto the canvas or click: the node goes after the selected one and joins it.
workflow.quick.tips: ↑↓ to pick, Enter to add, Esc to close
workflow.inspector.label: Label
workflow.inspector.unwire: Remove the wire and set the value here
workflow.inspector.wireHint: Set a field here or wire another node's output into it: the wired value wins.
workflow.targets.total: Total: {total}%. At 100% the rounding rest goes to the last one.
workflow.settings.title: Workflow settings
workflow.settings.hint: Select a node to set it up. Here is what applies to the whole workflow.
workflow.settings.capHint: A run that would move or spend more does not run at all.
workflow.settings.reactHint: Usually off, so workflows never fire each other in circles. A workflow never reacts to its own operations.
workflow.hotkey.quickAdd: add a node at the cursor
workflow.hotkey.toggle: switch a node off or on
workflow.list.intro: A workflow is an automation made of nodes: a trigger decides when it runs, the other nodes what to do. Money moves at once unless a «Wait for confirmation» node comes first.
workflow.list.empty: No workflows yet. Take a template above or make a new one: start with a trigger.
workflow.import.title: Import a workflow
workflow.import.description: Paste a workflow's text copied with «Copy as text». It arrives switched off.
workflow.import.label: Workflow text
workflow.runs.intro: Every run step by step: what fired, which values went on, why a workflow stopped.
workflow.queue.intro: Workflows wait for you here: questions from «Wait for confirmation», prepared operations and sleeping runs.
workflow.queue.empty: Nothing waits: no questions, operations or sleeping runs.
workflow.queue.questionsIntro: A workflow stopped at a «Wait for confirmation» node. «Yes» and «No» go on along their way.
workflow.vars.intro: Values that live between runs. Shared ones are seen by every workflow: change the «savings share» here and all of them use it.
workflow.vars.empty: No variables yet. «Set a variable» nodes create them, or the «New» button.
workflow.vars.description: A shared variable: «Get a variable» reads it with the «shared» place.
workflow.vars.name: Name
workflow.template.salaryShare.name: 10% of the salary into savings
workflow.template.salaryShare.desc: A salary comes in, a share goes to savings. Choose where.
workflow.template.lowBalance.name: Low balance on the card
workflow.template.lowBalance.desc: The balance drops below a threshold: a notice, at most once a day.
workflow.template.weeklyBuy.name: A weekly buy
workflow.template.weeklyBuy.desc: Every Friday it asks you and after «Yes» exchanges a set sum.
workflow.template.payday.name: Salary and advance: a reminder
workflow.template.payday.desc: On the 1st it finds the advance (10th) and salary (25th) days, moves them to Friday or another working day when they fall on a weekend or a holiday, and sets a reminder to book the income.
workflow.template.payday.advance: The advance is in: book the income
workflow.template.payday.salary: The salary is in: book the income
workflow.template.workdayPayment.name: A payment on a working day
workflow.template.workdayPayment.desc: On the 10th a payment reminder; on a weekend or holiday, the next working day.
workflow.template.workdayPayment.today: The loan payment is due today
workflow.template.budgetWatch.name: The budget is nearly spent
workflow.template.budgetWatch.desc: Every evening checks a limit and tells you when 90% or more is spent.
tour.workflows.tabs.title: Workflows
tour.workflows.tabs.body: The workflows, shared variables, the queue of operations to confirm and the journal of runs.
tour.workflows.templates.title: Templates
tour.workflows.templates.body: Open one: in the editor you only pick the accounts and switch it on.
tour.workflows.new.title: Your own
tour.workflows.new.body: An empty canvas: start with a trigger, then Ctrl+Space offers the nodes that fit.
tour.workflows.card.title: A workflow
tour.workflows.card.body: The switch turns it on; the last run's result is under the name.
tour.workflows.vars.title: Variables
tour.workflows.vars.body: Values shared by every workflow: change them here, not in each one.
tour.workflows.queue.title: Queue
tour.workflows.queue.body: Operations after «Wait for confirmation» wait here for your yes.
tour.workflows.runs.title: Journal
tour.workflows.runs.body: Open a run to see every step and the values it went with.
tour.workflowEditor.canvas.title: Canvas
tour.workflowEditor.canvas.body: Square ports are the flow (what runs next), round ones data; the colour is the value's type. Drag a wire from an output to an input. Hold Space and drag to move the canvas.
tour.workflowEditor.palette.title: Nodes
tour.workflowEditor.palette.body: Triggers, data, logic, variables and actions. Drag onto the canvas or click.
tour.workflowEditor.quick.title: Ctrl+Space
tour.workflowEditor.quick.body: Adds a node at the cursor and wires it: after the selected node, into the selected wire, or to the port you dragged into empty space. Understands «10%» and «> 5000».
tour.workflowEditor.inspector.title: Settings
tour.workflowEditor.inspector.body: The selected node's fields and its help (F1). With nothing selected: the workflow's settings and its problems.
tour.workflowEditor.emulate.title: Emulation
tour.workflowEditor.emulate.body: Runs the workflow on a copy of your data: you see every step and the values on the wires, nothing is kept.
tour.workflowEditor.active.title: Switch on
tour.workflowEditor.active.body: A workflow switched on watches its triggers from that moment. With errors it cannot be switched on.
tour.workflowEditor.save.title: Save
tour.workflowEditor.save.body: Ctrl+S. The previous version is kept in the history.
whatsNew.round15.title: Workflows ask you; the exchange counts
whatsNew.round15.confirm: «Wait for confirmation» now really pauses the run: the question shows under «Queue», and «Yes» and «No» lead their own ways. In emulation you answer right in the run panel.
whatsNew.round15.emulation: Emulation is closer to a real run: after «Wait» dates and reminders count from the moment the run would wake, and events show which workflows they would start.
whatsNew.round15.hotkeys: Editor shortcuts work on any keyboard layout and after a click on the canvas; Shift+A adds a node when Ctrl+Space is taken by the language switch.
whatsNew.round15.nodes: New nodes: dates (parts, make, shift, between, start and end of a month, shift to a working day, date as text), text (find by a pattern, number from text, split, replace, join), «Convert type» into a number, date, amount or text, «Pick a value», «Round», «Switch» and list nodes.
whatsNew.round15.loops: Loops: «Repeat N times», «Count from … to», «While» and «Break the loop».
whatsNew.round15.payday: The «Salary and advance» template: on the 1st it moves pay days off weekends to a working day and sets a reminder to book the income. Lesson: «Pay day and weekends».
whatsNew.round15.chain: Set a variable, notices and reminders need no «Next», and with no wire into «In» they run by themselves at the end of the run; a variable read after a write has the new value.
whatsNew.round15.drafts: You can leave the workflow editor without saving: keep the edits as a draft (the saved workflow keeps working) or throw them away; «Undo the edits» brings the saved version back.
whatsNew.round15.currencies: Chart tooltips show values in the base and favourite currencies; hovering an amount in any currency shows it in them at once. Wallet, portfolio and utility charts get a currency switch: the base one or a favourite.
whatsNew.round15.bybitWidget: The «Bybit sync» dashboard widget: confirm loaded operations one by one or all at once.
whatsNew.round15.bybitSettings: Exchange settings get «Import» (what to load and where: accounts, kinds of operations, categories, coins, a date), «Syncs» (the load history) and «Exchange operations». Before saving you can preview what these settings would load.
whatsNew.round15.pickers: Accounts, assets and currencies are picked with the same fields everywhere: with the «Wallet › Sub-account» path and favourite currencies first.
whatsNew.round15.adjustment: A correction opened again shows all its rows and keeps every asset; saving an operation again no longer moves it in time.
whatsNew.round15.exchange: Exchange operations get the «Exchange import» mark, are never imported twice, and when the ledger still disagrees with the exchange the live balance is set by a correction.
whatsNew.round15.settings: Settings open from the gear in the header; the sidebar item is gone.
whatsNew.round14.title: Node workflows
whatsNew.round14.workflows: A new «Workflows» section: automations made of nodes: triggers, conditions, variables, data from other nodes and actions.
whatsNew.round14.editor: An editor with Ctrl+Space node search: it offers only what fits a port or a wire and understands «10%», «> 5000».
whatsNew.round14.emulation: Emulation on a copy of your data: every step in words and the values on the wires, with no risk to real accounts.
whatsNew.round14.queue: A workflow moves money at once; a «Wait for confirmation» node sends operations to a queue for your yes.
whatsNew.round14.workday: A «Working day?» node: weekends, Russian holidays and your own transfers, so a payment never lands on a day off.
workflow.explain.wouldMake: For real it would make operations: {count}.
workflow.explain.nothing: Nothing was done: no action follows the trigger, or the conditions let none through.
workflow.explain.failed: Error: {detail}. Everything the run had done is undone.
workflow.explain.waiting: It sleeps until {detail} and goes on by itself.
workflow.explain.asking: It stopped at the question «{detail}» and waits for your «Yes» or «No».
workflow.lesson.safe: The check runs on a copy of your data: accounts do not change. You need not save a lesson.
workflow.lesson.first.title: Your first workflow
workflow.lesson.first.goal: A workflow that shows a notice at the press of a button.
workflow.lesson.first.hint: Drag «Run by hand» and «Notification» from the list on the left. Drag from the trigger's «Next» to the notice's «In». Type the text on the right with the notice selected.
workflow.lesson.first.check.trigger: There is a «Run by hand» trigger
workflow.lesson.first.check.wire: The flow goes from the trigger to the notice
workflow.lesson.data.title: Data along wires
workflow.lesson.data.goal: Let the notice tell today's date by itself.
workflow.lesson.data.hint: Add «Now» and «Build text» with the template «Today is {a}». The «Date» output goes into {a}, the «Text» output into the notice's «Text»: a wired value replaces the field.
workflow.lesson.data.check.into: The text goes into the notice
workflow.lesson.condition.title: A condition
workflow.lesson.condition.goal: Every day at 10:00 a notice, but only on days off.
workflow.lesson.condition.text: A day off: rest from spending
workflow.lesson.condition.hint: Ctrl+Space on the selected schedule offers «Branch». Take its «Condition» from «Working day?»: the «Working» output → «Condition», and wire the notice to the «No» way.
workflow.lesson.condition.check.branch: Its answer goes into the branch's «Condition»
workflow.lesson.condition.check.notify: One of the ways leads to the notice
workflow.lesson.condition.check.emulate: The emulation went through the branch
workflow.lesson.quick.title: Quick add
workflow.lesson.quick.goal: Put «10% of the salary» between the amount and the text, in one command.
workflow.lesson.quick.hint: Click the wire from «Value» to «Build text», press Ctrl+Space, type «10%» and Enter: the node takes its place in the wire.
workflow.lesson.quick.check.percent: There is a «Math» with «10% of A»
workflow.lesson.quick.check.onward: The result goes into the text
workflow.lesson.money.title: Money with confirmation
workflow.lesson.money.goal: A transfer between your accounts that waits for your yes.
workflow.lesson.money.hint: After the trigger put «Wait for confirmation» and wire «Create an operation» to its «Yes»: kind «transfer», an account with money, where to, an amount. The emulation stops at the question: answer «Yes» and it shows the transfer; real accounts stay as they are.
workflow.lesson.money.check.confirm: The trigger leads to «Wait for confirmation»
workflow.lesson.money.check.accounts: The operation has an account and an amount
workflow.lesson.money.check.answered: You answered «Yes» in the emulation and the transfer would be made
workflow.lesson.payday.title: Pay day and weekends
workflow.lesson.payday.goal: A reminder on pay day, and on the Friday before when the 25th is a day off.
workflow.lesson.payday.hint: Add «Make a date» (day 25), wire its output to «Shift to a working day» (back), and its date into the «Date» input of a «Create a reminder» that follows the trigger. The emulation shows the day the reminder lands on.
workflow.lesson.payday.check.shift: Its date goes into «Shift to a working day»
workflow.lesson.payday.check.remind: The moved date is the reminder's «Date»
workflow.lesson.payday.check.emulate: The emulation would set the reminder
tour.workflows.lessons.title: Lessons
tour.workflows.lessons.body: Five short tasks on a copy of your data, from a first workflow to a transfer with confirmation.
tour.workflowEditor.lesson.title: Lesson
tour.workflowEditor.lesson.body: The task and its steps: they tick by themselves as you build.
whatsNew.round14.lessons: Workflow lessons: a task on the canvas, steps tick by themselves, the check is a risk-free emulation.
workflow.field.callableHint: Only workflows that start with a «Called by a workflow» trigger are listed.
workflow.note.label: Note text
workflow.note.placeholder: What this part of the workflow does…
workflow.versions.title: Versions
workflow.versions.empty: No earlier versions yet: they appear when a changed workflow is saved.
workflow.versions.restored: Version restored; the current one is kept in the history
workflow.tests.title: Tests
workflow.tests.empty: No tests yet. Emulate the saved workflow and press «Save as a test»: you will notice when an edit changes what it does.
workflow.tests.hint: Each test emulates the workflow at its moment and compares the outcome, the operations and the notices.
workflow.tests.savedOnly: The saved version is tested: save your changes first.
tour.workflowEditor.tests.title: Tests and versions
tour.workflowEditor.tests.body: A saved emulation becomes a test: after edits one button shows whether anything broke. Earlier versions can be put back.
whatsNew.round14.subflows: Helper workflows: «Call a workflow» runs a shared part inside the run and gets its answer.
whatsNew.round14.tests: Workflow tests by emulation, a version history to restore from, and notes on the canvas.
workflow.hotkey.pan: hold and drag: move the canvas along X and Y, even over nodes
whatsNew.round14.spacePan: In the workflow editor hold Space and drag: the canvas moves along X and Y from any point, even over nodes.
